sourceItems.title: 进口可用作原料的固体废物环境保护控制标准—废纸或纸板
normalizedClaims: GB 16487.4-2017 tightened environmental-control requirements for imported waste paper and took effect on March 1, 2018.
observedChanges: imported recycled-fiber access becomes more constrained and compliance-sensitive

sourceItems.title: 龙头外废配额较大，成本优势显著
normalizedClaims: The first ten 2018 waste-paper import-license batches approved about 9.4431 million tons, down 65.7% versus the first ten batches of 2017.
Quota shares were concentrated among leaders: Nine Dragons about 36%, Lee & Man 16%, Shanying 13% and Guangzhou Paper 8%.
At the time, corrugated-paper and domestic-OCC prices were roughly stable, so the quota/access change could precede a clearer downstream spread response.
observedChanges: industry imported-fiber availability falls sharply while quota access concentrates in leaders

sourceItems.title: 废纸配额集中与龙头成本优势跟踪
normalizedClaims: The first eleven 2018 import-waste-paper batches totaled roughly 11.01 million tons and the top three groups received about 61.8% of quota.
The report estimated a material raw-fiber cost gap between quota-rich leaders able to use imported waste paper and smaller mills relying mainly on domestic waste paper.
observedChanges: relative raw-material state improves for quota-rich leaders even while industry-wide fiber scarcity worsens

sourceItems.title: 工程机械景气度高企 龙头股强者恒强
normalizedClaims: May excavator sales were 19,313 units, +71.3% YoY and a historical monthly high.
Jan-May excavator sales were 105,935 units, +60.2% YoY; exports were +103.9% YoY.
observedChanges: physical equipment demand remains exceptionally strong through May

sourceItems.title: 5月挖掘机销售19313台 前5月累计超10万台
sourceItems.publisher: 中国工程机械工业协会挖掘机械分会/第一工程机械网
normalizedClaims: Association data independently recorded strong Jan-May 2018 excavator volumes and continued high YoY growth.
observedChanges: industry volume remains high despite a high comparison base

sourceItems.title: 关于2018年光伏发电有关事项的通知（发改能源〔2018〕823号）
sourceItems.publisher: 国家发展改革委/财政部/国家能源局
normalizedClaims: The policy temporarily stopped arranging 2018 construction quota for ordinary subsidized PV power stations.
About 10GW was arranged for distributed PV, while subsidy/tariff policy was tightened.
observedChanges: domestic subsidized PV demand path is abruptly reset lower

sourceItems.title: 国家能源局新能源司和国家发展改革委价格司负责同志就《关于2018年光伏发电有关事项的通知》答记者问
normalizedClaims: Officials confirmed the pause in ordinary subsidized station quota and clarified the roughly 10GW distributed-PV arrangement.
observedChanges: policy shock is confirmed as a real demand-side reset rather than rumor

sourceItems.title: Price Decline Will Continue in NAND Flash Market in 2H18 due to Weak Growth Momentum
normalizedClaims: NAND contract prices had already declined for two consecutive quarters in 1H18.
64/72-layer 3D NAND yield/output kept improving while smartphone/notebook/tablet demand growth was weak; further price declines were expected.
observedChanges: supply/output state outruns demand and pushes the product cycle downward

sourceItems.title: 5G独立组网标准出台
normalizedClaims: 3GPP approved the 5G NR standalone standard, completing a major first-phase standardization milestone and enabling further equipment testing and network preparation.
observedChanges: 5G moves from incomplete standards toward a testable standalone architecture

sourceItems.title: MSCI Global Standard Indexes May 2018 Semi-Annual Index Review
normalizedClaims: MSCI announced the first partial inclusion step for China A shares: 234 names at a 2.5% inclusion factor, with a second step scheduled for August.
The aggregate A-share weight in the MSCI Emerging Markets Index was initially small, so the event primarily changed portfolio-flow access rather than issuer earnings.
observedChanges: scheduled benchmark-linked foreign demand becomes operational

eventClusters.statement: Imported recycled-fiber availability fell sharply under tighter waste-paper rules, while import quota became concentrated in a handful of packaging-paper leaders, potentially creating a relative raw-material cost state that precedes visible downstream paper-margin differentiation.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Industry-wide imported-fiber scarcity can raise domestic OCC costs and hurt all producers. Deep research must distinguish absolute industry pressure from relative quota/access advantage and prove that a listed leader can convert that state into earnings without the benefit already being fully priced.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does concentrated imported-fiber access create a cutoff-valid, measurable cost/earnings advantage for an A-share packaging-paper leader before downstream paper-price/margin flows fully reflect it?

eventClusters.statement: May excavator sales reached a historical monthly high and Jan-May volumes remained up about 60% YoY, preserving a strong physical machinery cycle into late Q2.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The cycle has already been strong for many quarters. Deep research must test leader earnings/valuation and high-base risk rather than treating record unit sales as automatically under-reflected.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Do leading machinery companies still have measurable earnings/expectation room at June 30 after the high-growth cycle has become widely visible?

eventClusters.statement: The June 1 '531' policy abruptly reduced the 2018 subsidized domestic PV construction path by pausing ordinary station quota and limiting distributed-PV support.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Long-run grid parity and cost decline can favor efficient leaders later, but the cutoff event is a near-term demand shock. Do not import later policy relief or recovery into the June 30 decision.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there already a company-specific cost/share engine strong enough to offset the immediate domestic demand reset, or should the Skill fail closed?

eventClusters.statement: NAND had entered an oversupply/price-downcycle as 64/72-layer yields and bit output improved faster than weak end-demand growth.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Lower NAND prices may benefit downstream storage buyers, but no positive A-share expression should be invented without a direct earnings bridge.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does the falling NAND state create any direct positive A-share earnings expression, or is it only a negative product-cycle control?

eventClusters.statement: 3GPP completed the 5G standalone standard, removing a technical-standardization dependency and enabling further testing, but commercial operator capex/order conversion was still a separate later step.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: A completed standard is structurally important but not itself a supplier revenue event. Deep research must require orders/earnings rather than buying standardization beta.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does any A-share supplier have a cutoff-valid order/earnings bridge from SA completion, or should this remain non-actionable?

eventClusters.statement: MSCI implemented the first partial inclusion of China A shares at a 2.5% inclusion factor, creating scheduled benchmark-linked foreign flows without directly changing issuer operating earnings.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Index demand can affect prices but is not a company earnings bridge. Do not map generic large-cap beneficiaries unless a direct monetization mechanism exists.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there any direct company-level earnings conversion, or should the event remain a broad market-flow observation without stock selection?
